title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
description:
Given an array prices where prices[i] is the stock price on day i, buy once and sell once on a later day. Return the maximum profit, or 0 if no profit is possible.

Example 1:
Input: prices = [7,1,5,3,6,4]
Output: 5
Explanation: Buy at 1 (day 1), sell at 6 (day 4)

Example 2:
Input: prices = [7,6,4,3,1]
Output: 0
Explanation: The price only goes down, so no trade is profitable

Constraints:
- 1 ≤ len(prices) ≤ 10^5
- 0 ≤ prices[i] ≤ 10^4
idea: Pointer l is the buy day, r is the sell day. If prices[r] is higher than prices[l], compute the profit and update the maximum. Otherwise a cheaper day was found, so move the buy day: l = r.
